desc: Your rings are sure to handle just about any recoil you can throw at them. With its four-screw system and steel cap, Weave Sure Grip Windage Adjustable Scope Rings offer you unsurpassed dependability. Once you mount a pair of Sure Grip Windage Adjustable Rings to your Weaver cross lock top mount bases you'll be ensured that zeroing in your scope to the critical optical clarity zone is a certainty.
